CustomField.description: Auto-populated from the related Opportunity's Amount at Case creation, via Case_Field_Mapping__c / CaseFieldMappingEngine. Case Fields sheet, All Cases section, row "Total Annual Amount (TAA)" - the sheet's own cited source field (Opportunity_Total_Annual_Amount__c) doesn't exist; per explicit direction this copies the standard Opportunity.Amount instead. Note: Opportunity also has its own separate Eligible_Annual_Amount__c custom field for a related but distinct reporting/incentive purpose - not the source used here.
CustomField.label: Total Annual Amount (TAA)
